rows.claim: Microsoft acquired LinkedIn in 2016.
rows.note: Deal announced June 13, 2016 and closed December 8, 2016 for $26.2B. Source says: "The acquisition was completed on December 8, 2016."

rows.claim: Stripe was founded by Patrick and John Collison.
rows.note: Multiple sources (Wikipedia, Forbes, NPR) confirm brothers Patrick and John Collison founded Stripe (2010). Source says: "Irish entrepreneur brothers John and Patrick Collison founded Stripe"

rows.claim: Figma went public on the NYSE in 2025.
rows.note: Multiple sources confirm Figma IPO'd on NYSE under ticker FIG on July 31, 2025. Source says: "The company went public on July 31, with shares opening at $85"

rows.claim: Google acquired YouTube in 2006.
rows.note: Google announced YouTube deal Oct 9, 2006 ($1.65B stock), completed Nov 13, 2006 per SEC filing, Wikipedia, Britannica. Source says: "The deal was finalized on November 13, 2006."

rows.claim: Salesforce acquired Slack.
rows.note: Salesforce completed its $27.7B acquisition of Slack on July 21, 2021 (press release, SEC 8-K, news reports). Source says: "today announced it has completed its acquisition of Slack Technologies, Inc."

rows.claim: Adobe completed its acquisition of Figma.
rows.note: Adobe and Figma terminated the $20B merger on Dec 18, 2023 over EU/UK regulatory hurdles; Figma later IPO'd. Source says: "entered into a mutual agreement to terminate their previously announced merger agreement"

rows.claim: Tesla was founded by Elon Musk in 1999.
rows.note: Tesla was founded in 2003 by Eberhard and Tarpenning; Musk joined in 2004 as an investor and was named co-founder only via a 2009 settlement. Source says: "Tesla Motors was founded as an electric carmaker by engineers Martin Eberhard and Marc Tarpenning in 2003."

rows.claim: Airbnb has never been a publicly traded company.
rows.note: Airbnb IPO'd on Nasdaq (ABNB) on Dec 10, 2020 at $68/share; listed as a public company. Source says: "Airbnb completed their IPO on December 10, 2020 to list on NASDAQ with ticker ABNB."

rows.claim: Nvidia completed its acquisition of Arm.
rows.note: Nvidia's $40B Arm deal was terminated in Feb 2022 over regulatory challenges (Nvidia, FTC, CRN, TechCrunch). Source says: "today announced the termination of the previously announced transaction whereby NVIDIA would acquire Arm Limited"

rows.claim: Netflix was founded in 2007 as a streaming company.
rows.note: Netflix was founded in 1997 as a DVD rental service; streaming only launched in 2007. Source says: "Netflix was founded by Marc Randolph and Reed Hastings as a DVD rental service on August 29, 1997"

iterations.strategy: Search the claim's key fact directly, using its core names, numbers and terms. Run a second query worded differently if the first results are thin. Judge only from what the sources say. Mark it supported when credible sources confirm every material detail. Mark it contradicted when credible sources state something incompatible with it. Mark it unclear when evidence is missing, partial or conflicting. Do not fill gaps with prior knowledge.
